answer: Proof, not pledges: Tile maker floor tile assay fired in the firing chamber asks for each floor tile is a firing record witnessed by the inspector, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. A 25% cut of the stake turns 170149 POA of farm deposits into a 25% loss at first detection. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. Take the pearl away and the name goes; take the karst away and the stake goes; take the orchard away and the past goes. Volume is the farm's trade and proof is the epoch's; the two trades never meet.
